scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@monitor/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace=@monitor/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.seed: npm run build --workspace=@monitor/shared && npm run build --workspace=@monitor/worker && npm run start --workspace=@monitor/worker
scripts.start: npm run seed && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace=@monitor/backend" "npm run dev --workspace=@monitor/frontend"
